records.text: Dana Loesch said a person cannot enter Russia unless invited by Russia.
records.speaker: Dana Loesch

appearances.snippet: But you know how difficult it is to get into Russia? Like you don't get into Russia unless Russia invites you.

verification.notes: Official Russian consular guidance provides tourist-entry paths based on a hotel booking or tour-operator confirmation, and the unified e-visa system expressly requires no invitation for eligible nationals. A person need not be personally invited by the Russian state to enter.

sources.title: Russian Foreign Ministry: Processing and issuance of visas for entry into Russia
sources.relevance: Lists ordinary tourist-visa documentation and does not require a personal invitation from the Russian state.

sources.title: Russian Foreign Ministry: Unified e-visa processing
sources.relevance: States that eligible e-visa applicants do not submit invitation letters or hotel confirmation.
